title: Fail flow (out of time, continue, level failed)
summary: The fail chain: Out of Time! / Out of Lives! offer, Continue? variants, then Level Failed with Try Again.
description: FailFlowDirector drives the chain from the session's .offer / .lost events (rules.json `failChain`, game.json `fail.*`): OutOfTimePopup (+30 sec for coins; Out of Lives! for hearts), ContinuePopup (streak / token / life / hearts-out variants, pays through the shop when short), LevelFailedPopup (Try Again). The streak strip under the panels is the streak-race component's.
gaps: Continue? and Level Failed draw the Streak Race strip and chips (StreakBanner.swift), so the fail flow depends on streak-race and, through it, on the events engine.
The generic offer popup for other genres' fail kinds (OfferPopup.swift: out of moves, stuck; texts in 13 languages) exists; its text fit is still to be measured on the Mac.

strings: Keep going with a few more moves!
You are stuck! Keep going with a little help.
